g.text: Independent backup cell, active case loop, reset and SE interlock

g.desc: Independent backup cell, active case loop, reset and SE interlock

g.text: PA1=TAMP_OUT4 -> three lid contacts -> PC13=TAMP_IN1; hardware active shared output4.

g.desc: PA1=TAMP_OUT4 -> three lid contacts -> PC13=TAMP_IN1; hardware active shared output4.

g.text: Separate SW12 asynchronously resets MCU/LCD and disables SE while main power is present.

g.desc: Separate SW12 asynchronously resets MCU/LCD and disables SE while main power is present.

g.text: PC1 is NOT tied to NRST: it is not a VBAT-capable input and a reset is not a lid event.

g.desc: PC1 is NOT tied to NRST: it is not a VBAT-capable input and a reset is not a lid event.

g.text: Backup register anchor + active engine continuity must be checked; loss/flag => quarantine, never factory blank.

g.desc: Backup register anchor + active engine continuity must be checked; loss/flag => quarantine, never factory blank.

g.text: No automatic flag clear/reseed on normal boot. No proof against bridging, probing, SCA or all glitches.
